description: Election Commission - T. P. A. Kumara was Selected as the member of the Bingiriya Pradeshiya Sabaha - P. M. Ameer Ali was Selected as the member of the Kathankudy U. C.
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Bingiriya Pradeshiya Sabha and Kattankudy Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, including the declaration of selected members to fill vacancies caused by resignation or party cessation, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral matters and declarations.
